item.title: Satel Netco Design
item.dc:creator: cisa
item.description:
View CSAF

Summary

Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in a user's browser, consume excessive system resources and potentially execute arbitrary code.

The following versions of Satel Netco Design are affected: Satel Netco Design.

Background

  • Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Communications

Vulnerabilities

CVE-2026-105269, CVE-2026-104628, CVE-2026-105275
